lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-contrast circular pixel clusters arranged in a regular 2D lattice pattern posterior to the gill slits on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form anchor nodes in a grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges on the upper flank showing a sharp transition from highlight on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Scattered low-contrast circular patches of higher luminance within the dorsal fin silhouette, partially obscured by surface caustic light patterns.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated dark pixel cluster consistent with a commensal fish (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral region near the pectoral fin base.
